_note: Official-source summaries for the November 12, 2026 demo. Coverage is limited to these records. Dates are publication dates.

items.title: NVIDIA Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026
items.text: NVIDIA filed quarterly results for the period ended July 26, 2026. It disclosed U.S. licensing restrictions on exports of certain chips to China. NVIDIA reported that restrictions on the Chinese side had limited sales even after the U.S. granted some H200 export licenses.

items.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.text: For the fiscal quarter ended July 26, 2026, NVIDIA reported total revenue of US$96.2 billion, 106% above the year-earlier quarter. Data Center revenue was US$89.0 billion, up 117% year over year.

items.title: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for Third-Quarter Financial Results
items.text: NVIDIA announced a November 17, 2026 call to discuss fiscal third-quarter results for the period ended October 25. The announcement set the release schedule and provided no third-quarter results.

items.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
items.text: The FOMC kept the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4.00%. The committee described inflation as elevated. Two members voted against the decision and preferred a 25-basis-point increase.

items.title: Bank of Canada raises the policy rate by 25 basis points to 2½%
items.text: The Bank of Canada increased its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.50%.
